name: marketing-app
description: Multi-project marketing attribution dashboard: spend per channel → leads → funnel → revenue, with a gap audit and end-to-end tracking SDK.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @runhq/sdk && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @runhq/server" "npm run dev -w @runhq/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @runhq/sdk && npm run build -w @runhq/web
